Research Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other online platforms to identify relevant trends, topics, formats and content ideas. Interest in photography, videography, filmmaking, social media, digital marketing or content creation is strongly preferred. Basic video editing knowledge using tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar applications will be an advantage. Knowledge of Canva, AI tools and emerging content-creation technologies will be an additional advantage. Must be creative, observant and capable of identifying potential content opportunities during everyday activities. Must have good communication skills and be comfortable working closely with the Founder and management team. Should be dedicated, responsible and able to work independently when required. Flexibility with working hours is important , as content creation may occasionally involve early mornings, evenings, weekends, events or travel.
